focus: frame-preposition: verb + à / de + infinitive, where French does not use the English preposition (conseiller / interdire / reprocher à qqn de, arrêter de, passer du temps à, au lieu de, plutôt que de, arriver à, avoir peur de)
calque: a real French word with the wrong meaning, or English word order carried over (dépenser for time, gentilement for gently, d'ailleurs for otherwise, pas important for never mind)
negation: ne ... jamais / pas encore / toujours pas, the slot around the auxiliary, ne in front of a negated infinitive, un becoming de
agreement: silent endings such as tu arrêtes, la plus chère, mes parents, the participle after a preceding direct object
tense: the futur after quand / dès que, imparfait against passé composé, si + plus-que-parfait
pronoun: direct against indirect object (lui / l'), dont, y and en

scenarios.title: Chez le médecin
scenarios.blurb: A check-up that turns into a lecture. Advice, bans and promises.
scenarios.setting: You are at a routine appointment. You have been tired, you smoke, and you do not sleep well.
scenarios.ai: a frank, kind doctor in a city surgery
scenarios.goal: Explain how you feel, understand the advice, and say what you will actually do.
scenarios.opener: Bonjour, installez-vous. Alors, qu'est-ce qui vous amène aujourd'hui ?

scenarios.title: Le nouvel appartement
scenarios.blurb: Telling a friend about a flat hunt, and an old friend who found one.
scenarios.setting: You meet a friend for coffee. You are moving next year and have not told your parents yet.
scenarios.ai: a chatty friend of yours, a little nosy
scenarios.goal: Talk about the move, who you have told, and what the new place is like compared with the old one.
scenarios.opener: Alors, c'est vrai que tu penses déménager ? Raconte !

scenarios.title: Le train en retard
scenarios.blurb: A cancelled train, a missed meeting, and who is to blame.
scenarios.setting: You are on a platform. Your train is delayed again and you have a meeting in an hour.
scenarios.ai: a station employee at the information desk
scenarios.you: a traveller who is trying to stay polite
scenarios.goal: Find out what happened, what your options are, and get on another train.
scenarios.opener: Bonjour monsieur, madame. Je vous écoute, vous avez un problème avec votre train ?

scenarios.title: Au restaurant
scenarios.setting: A small restaurant, a busy evening. You are with one other person and one of you is a bit fussy.
scenarios.goal: Order a meal, ask about the dishes, and deal with something that is not quite right.
scenarios.opener: Bonsoir, bienvenue. Vous avez choisi, ou je vous laisse encore un moment ?

scenarios.title: Le voisin bruyant
scenarios.blurb: A polite complaint that has to stay polite.
scenarios.setting: You knock on your neighbour's door at 11 p.m. The music has been loud for three nights.
scenarios.ai: a neighbour, a bit defensive at first, who can be talked round
scenarios.goal: Explain the problem, ask them to stop, and agree on something.
scenarios.opener: Oui ? Ah, c'est vous. Il y a un problème ?

scenarios.title: Le week-end dernier
scenarios.blurb: Telling a story in the past. Background against events.
scenarios.setting: Monday morning at work. A colleague asks what you did.
scenarios.goal: Tell what happened at the weekend, in order, with what was going on around it.
scenarios.opener: Salut ! Alors, c'était comment, ton week-end ? Tu as fait quelque chose de sympa ?

scenarios.title: Un entretien d'embauche
scenarios.blurb: Answer questions about your past and your plans, and ask some back.
scenarios.setting: A job interview for a role you would really like. The interviewer is friendly but exact.
scenarios.goal: Present your experience, explain a gap or a change, and say where you want to be in five years.
scenarios.opener: Bonjour, merci d'être venu. Pour commencer, pouvez-vous vous présenter en quelques mots ?

scenarios.title: Free conversation
scenarios.blurb: Pick your own topic. The model follows you.
scenarios.setting: Whatever you want. Say what you would like to talk about in your first message, in French or in English.
scenarios.ai: a friendly French speaker of your age who is curious about you
scenarios.opener: Salut ! De quoi as-tu envie de parler aujourd'hui ?
